## CV Keyword Optimizer (Zero-OAuth / Webhook API)

1. Webhook receives CV text + JD from Web UI
2. AI Brain Stage 1 (Groq): JD Gap Analysis & ATS Keyword Extraction
3. AI Brain Stage 2 (Groq): Executive Resume Re-write & Optimization
4. Formatter: Generates Markdown, ATS-styled HTML, and Plain Text
5. Webhook Response: Returns multi-format documents and diff log to Web UI
